check_qrtag_link.description: Find out where a qrtag.net link (the link inside a qrtag.net QR code) forwards to, and whether it still works. qrtag.net says it keeps these links for 3 days, so use this before sharing an older code again. The destination is read without visiting it. No account or API key required.

create_qr_code.description: Turn a web address into a QR code image to show on a screen straight away: in a chat, a slide or an email. The code opens a qrtag.net link that forwards to your address, and qrtag.net says it keeps that link for 3 days, so don't use it for anything printed. Each code is checked before it's saved, so you get the link it opens and where that goes. Some sites, such as google.com, are blocked by qrtag.net. No account or API key required.

description: Make a QR code for a link with qrtag.net, to show on a screen right away: in a chat, on a slide or in an email. Choose PNG or SVG, a transparent background and the size. The code opens a qrtag.net link that forwards to your address, and qrtag.net says it keeps that link for 3 days, so it's made for sharing now, not for print. Every code is read back before it's saved, so a code qrtag.net refused to make properly (some sites, such as google.com, are blocked) is reported instead of saved. No account or API key required.
